decisions.reason: As a flagship business-unit expansion tightly linked to core ship management and future offshore and renewable demand, its strategic upside outweighs the cost of keeping the option open.
Because it builds directly on existing crew and travel capabilities and can be offered with limited additional commitment, management would likely keep it despite still-uncertain demand conditions.
As a flagship digital extension of the established vessel-management offer, it has scalable upside and relatively low holding costs, so the firm would likely continue it.

This app is complementary but less central than the flagship launches, making it the most disposable option, yet its adjacency to the core business and likely modest carrying cost still support keeping it for now.
